resistance_buildings.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production spritesheet for a 2D real-time strategy game. Create ONE precise 3 by 3 grid atlas, 1536x1536 pixels, 9 equally sized 512x512 cells. Background MUST be truly transparent alpha, absolutely no colored backdrop or checkerboard. Each cell contains exactly one isolated complete building sprite centered horizontally, bottom of footprint at 85% of cell height, with generous clear margins, NO objects across cell boundaries. All 9 buildings seen from identical fixed orthographic game camera, azimuth 45 degrees, elevation 55 degrees, north-west soft daylight with short shadows only immediately under objects. Original detailed pre-rendered 3D-to-2D sprite aesthetic of classic late 1990s / early 2000s military RTS games, materially realistic and readable when shrunk to 128 pixels. Not cartoon, not flat vector, not low poly. A resistance army on alien-occupied Earth. Olive drab patched concrete, sandbags, salvaged civilian metal, realistic weathering, tiny desaturated turquoise identification panels. US militia survival equipment. Layout is mandatory in row-major order. Row 1: command headquarters with antenna, power generator, resource refinery/depot with loading bay. Row 2: infantry barracks, vehicle factory with large garage door, advanced research laboratory with radar dish. Row 3: medical support station, defensive gun turret, faction superweapon silo or alien bombardment nexus. All buildings need different recognizable silhouettes and convincing concrete/metal panel details, pipes, vents, doors and roof structure. Nothing cut off. No text, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no logos, no borders, no surrounding terrain. This is a practical game atlas, not a poster.

units_directions.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production directional mobile-unit sprite atlas for a 2D military RTS game. ONE exact 8-column by 6-row evenly spaced grid, 2048 by 1536 pixels. Each 256x256 cell holds ONE isolated full unit, centered, generous transparent margins. TRUE transparent alpha background, no white, no checkerboard, no ground, no grid, no text or labels. Fixed orthographic camera at elevation 55 degrees, identical lighting from upper left, realistic pre-rendered 3D-to-2D sprite aesthetic of classic detailed military real time strategy, not flat cartoon. Each ROW has the SAME subject turned through exactly 8 compass directions: columns left to right face east, southeast, south, southwest, west, northwest, north, northeast. Keep same subject identity/materials and same apparent scale within a row. Row 1: realistic resistance rifleman in olive fatigues, backpack and worn helmet, long rifle, tiny muted turquoise armband. Row 2: realistic six-legged alien skitter warrior with dark brown chitin shell, violet eyes, angular head. Row 3: realistic outlaw human raider with brown leather vest, grey jeans, assault rifle, rust-orange armband. Row 4: realistic olive drab tracked light tank, long rotating gun, chipped metal, tiny turquoise marking. Row 5: realistic tall alien bipedal armored mech with bulky gun arms, dark gunmetal armor and restrained violet plasma strips. Row 6: realistic postapocalyptic technical pickup truck with rusty improvised steel armor, heavy roof gun, orange paint remnants. No scenery, no bases, no captions, no overlapping cells, no cropped legs or barrels. Infantry full height about 130 pixels per cell, vehicles width/height around 185 pixels, readable silhouettes with detailed believable materials.

terrain_materials.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: terrain texture atlas for a realistic postapocalyptic military 2D RTS video game. Create ONE image 1536x1024, exact 3 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 square texture tiles, edge to edge, no borders and no margins. Every cell is a completely flat orthographic overhead material texture, no perspective, no horizon, no shadows of objects, no text. Make highly realistic photogrammetry-style subtle and low contrast materials readable beneath small strategy-game units. Row 1 left to right: compacted dusty dry olive-brown earth with tiny stones; weathered short sparse green-brown grass; grey cracked asphalt with subtle worn aggregate, NO painted lines. Row 2 left to right: urban debris ground with small concrete fragments, dark dirt and gravel, no large objects; dark woodland soil with leaf litter and moss; alien corrupted grey-violet cracked earth with sparse dark crystalline fragments and subtle vein patterns, no strong glow. Each cell should be tileable seamlessly in both directions, broad uniform lighting, restrained desaturated palette, realistic tiny material details, no dramatic macro shapes, no large rocks or buildings or roads or vegetation plants. This atlas will be cut into six tiles and used as the actual ground of a game.
